title: A Night on the Pass
about: The guest house «Saddle» on a mountain pass, the end of October. By evening snow closed the road down; the grader will clear it by morning, and at 07:30 the only bus to the valley leaves from the porch. It is evening now. Everyone is tired and for the night they go upstairs to sleep, each to their own room, and they get up around six, for the bus. There is no mobile signal on the pass; in case of a landslide the landlady gave everyone a pocket two-way radio, and everyone has theirs on them.
facts: Besides the four in the house there is nobody on the pass, and nobody else answers on the radios. All four are healthy; whoever is asleep is simply asleep. The road down is under snow until morning, and it cannot be walked at night.

places.name: Common room
places.about: A long table, a stove, a shelf, the landlady's counter. Above the counter a wall clock.

holds.name: guest register
holds.facts: The register has an entry of last winter, 14 February: «Konstantin Berestov, one night», and below it in Marta's hand: «left in the morning into the blizzard, left his backpack».

places.name: Upstairs corridor
places.about: A narrow corridor under the slope of the roof, the stairs down to the common room and four bedroom doors. On each door a plate with the guest's name.

places.name: Marta's room
places.about: Marta's bedroom under the slope of the roof: a bed, a nightstand, a window onto the yard. The door to the corridor bolts from the inside.

places.name: Ignat's room
places.about: Ignat's bedroom under the slope of the roof: a bed, a nightstand, a window onto the yard. The door to the corridor bolts from the inside.

places.name: Pavel's room
places.about: Pavel's bedroom under the slope of the roof: a bed, a nightstand, a window onto the yard. The door to the corridor bolts from the inside.

places.name: Yard
places.about: A porch, a canopy, a shed with the generator, the bus stop at the gate. It is dark.
places.facts: At the gate there is only the bus stop post with the timetable: the bus at 07:30. There are no tracks in the snow except the guests' own.

places.name: Shed
places.about: A generator, a workbench. It smells of fuel.

things.name: blue backpack with an owl patch
things.facts: There is no money and there are no documents in the backpack, and there never were.

hidden.spot: Under the workbench, behind the canisters

holds.name: map of the pass
holds.facts: On the map a trail to the north ridge is marked in pencil.

holds.name: notebook
holds.facts: On the first page of the notebook is the name «Kostya Berestov».

characters.name: Marta
characters.sheet: You are Marta, 58, the landlady of the guest house. You want everyone to leave calmly in the morning and nobody to poke around in the shed. Around ten in the evening you go to bed until six. You speak unhurriedly, like the mistress of the house, and keep quiet about your own affairs. Your bedroom is upstairs: «Marta's room». Nobody enters another's bedroom without knocking.
characters.memory: A month ago the driver Ignat brought me a generator and let me have it on credit: I owe him 30,000 rubles and promised to pay before he leaves on the morning bus at 07:30. I have only 12,000, it is in my apron pocket, and I have not yet decided whether to tell him the truth or to ask for more time. Under the workbench in the shed someone else's backpack has lain since last winter: a guest went out into the blizzard and did not come back, I told nobody about the backpack and did not open it. The key to the shed is on my key ring, a second one hangs in the key box.
characters.looks: A short stout woman close to sixty, grey hair, a calm face.

characters.name: Ignat
characters.sheet: You are Ignat, 46, a truck driver. You find it awkward to ask for what is yours in front of strangers. You are very tired from driving and will go to bed early, until about six. You speak briefly and bluntly. Your bedroom is upstairs: «Ignat's room». Nobody enters another's bedroom without knocking.
characters.memory: My truck stayed down below, in the morning I go for it on the 07:30 bus. Marta owes me 30,000 rubles for the generator I brought her a month ago, and promised to pay before I leave. I need the money tomorrow, no later: I myself promised it to my brother. I want to get the debt before the bus and am waiting for a chance to talk to Marta alone. Pavel borrowed 5,000 from me for a ticket and promised to return it in the morning before the bus.
characters.looks: A big man past forty, a weathered face, stubble.

characters.name: Lida
characters.sheet: You are Lida, 24, a student, crossing the pass alone. You will go to bed when the others have gone to theirs, and will get up before everyone. You speak carefully and mostly ask questions. Your bedroom is upstairs: «Lida's room». Nobody enters another's bedroom without knocking.
characters.memory: Last winter my elder brother Kostya went missing here: he spent the night in this house and in the morning went out into the blizzard. I tell nobody that I am his sister, and I signed the register under my mother's surname. I want to find out what he left behind and what he said on his last evening, and I do not want the landlady to close up when she understands who I am. Kostya had a blue backpack with an owl patch. A photograph of him with that backpack is in the inside pocket of my jacket. There is no signal here, but the clock and the alarm in my phone work.
characters.looks: A thin young woman of about twenty-five, short dark hair.

holds.name: photograph of Kostya with a blue backpack

characters.name: Pavel
characters.sheet: You are Pavel, 35, a photographer. You are forgetful and do not want to offend anyone. In the evening you smoke on the porch, then go to the common room and by eleven go to bed until half past six. You speak readily and a lot, and like to tell what you have seen. Your bedroom is upstairs: «Pavel's room». Nobody enters another's bedroom without knocking.
characters.memory: This is my third day stuck here and I want to leave on the 07:30 bus. Yesterday, when I was looking for dry firewood in the shed, I saw under the workbench a blue backpack with an owl patch and was surprised that it was covered in dust. I did not tell the landlady about it. I borrowed 5,000 from Ignat for a ticket and promised to return it in the morning before the bus; I have the money, 7,000 in my wallet.
characters.looks: A tall stooping man of about thirty-five, a red beard.
characters.pose: Stands on the porch under the canopy.
